nom: VANICREAM Vitamin C Facial Serum for Sensitive Skin

avis.texte: I love this product, it brightens up my skin and works well with my sensitive skin. I just bought another tube of it!!
I like what it does for my skin, but even though I use a very tiny amount on clean skin, it dries with a very sticky feel. Is there anything I can do to avoid this?
I have tried multiple high-end Vitamin C serums and they have broken me out instantly! This is my first time trying THD and now I'm actually able to use Vitamin C with no irritation.
This is only Vit C serum that doesn't break me out. It's not greasy and does good under makeup.

So cheap, so effective! The only thing that truly lightened my acne scars. I just finished my first bottle (it last for months) and i truly notice a real difference in the brightness of my skin. Plus the consistency is so nice and it doesn't clog my pores.

avis.titre: Best every day vitamin C cream
avis.texte: I've used many expensive vitamin c creams most of which have either oxidized before buying or soon after. I've even stored them in the fridge and yet they still turn orange and lose efficacy. Drunk Elephants vitamin C serum turned orange within days (even in the fridge) and did nothing at all. This vitamin C is soothing and doesn't cause inflammation. THD when used consistently will protect and soothe the skin. It's highly moisturizing with ceramides. When I want something stronger I buy Exuviance's vitamin C serum capsules which can irritate but work well for improving collagen and skin appearance. Vanicream vitamin C is my everyday cream.

I have redness/ rosacea flareups, especially in the winter. I was trying to pinpoint the cause. I switched the normal vitamin c serum to vanicream vitamin c serum. For the last two days, I have only used this plus la roche posts cicaplast balm b5+ ad a barrier cream over top. I can see improvement in just two days. Before and after pic included

avis.titre: Is a good serum when you are tight on budget
avis.texte: I normally use this to resolve and keep up the effects while being in a tight budget season. Is good for sensitive skin. For thise saying they are not seeing results is because this formulation uses a more hydrating and sensitive skin friendly version of vitamin c. You can not THD with a stronger abacorbic acid formulation. I would still recommend it.

I've used drunk elephant, naturium, timeless 20%, maelove glowmaker, and dr Brenner vitamin c serum. I found this version to cause redness and it also tasted like coconuts. If it didn't make my face so red (this happened with Timeless and drunk elephant too) I would love it but everytime I put it on I look sunburned.

I've only been using this for a few weeks, so I can't speak to its effectiveness completely (specifically if it has brightened my skin or not). But for my sensitive skin, I've had no issues with it. The serum feels hydrating and pairs well under makeup.

avis.titre: Not seeing results but still use
avis.texte: So been using this for 2 months. Absolutely no irritation and I have mature sensitive skin, however always haven't really seen any improvement. Will continue to use for the future benefit but hasn't smooth out my skin at all.Does feel great though, just wish it was stronger.

Just ordered my second and third tubes so i won't be out when tube one is empty. It's that good for my acne prone dry sensitive skin! Was recommended by a dermatologist I follow on Instagram for my exact skin type. No issues with irritation at all and my skin looks beautiful and glowy. Great price for such a good product. A little goes a long way.

This product is lightweight, moisturizing, and immediately helps even your skin tone and gives you a slight glow. I have somewhat sensitive skin and have had on going yeast issues with my face, so i cant have anything too heavy/greasy. It has a very light, pleasant scent.

I first purchased this about 6 months ago at my local grocery store and was surprised they carried it. I initially saw it as one of the listed products on a dermatologist's YouTube vid on vitamin C and thought it might be worth the try. I've tried others of varying price ranges, but I've continued with this one the most consistently for a few reasons. 1) The price point is great for the quality and value of the product. 2) it absorbs nicely and doesn't make my skin break out. Overall, it feels nice on my skin and I apply it on clean skin in the morning and at bedtime. 3) I've used some more expensive products that go on sticky and will pill up under my makeup or tinted sunscreen, even after they are dry. This one does NOT. 4) Maybe most importantly, when used consistently over time, I have found that this vitamin C has improve the overall texture of my skin and evened out my tone. I do notice if I miss a few days that my skin isn't as bright. For me, the product wasn't an overnight transformation, but I didn't expect it to be. It's part of my skincare routine that's effective overtime with consistency. It also works well under every sunscreen product I've used, which is important because you don't want to wear this without sunscreen if you're going to be outside. Great product and will continue to be used in my daily skincare routine.
Im happy to see this product here. Not happy about the price tag. Do better..

I've used a number of vitamin c products from high end to drug store and this is my favorite. My skin looks better immediately after I put it on, I do think it makes me look brighter and helps with acne scars over time, and it's super budget friendly. I also use a retinol and this doesn't negatively interact with that at all. My dermatologist was pleased with my choice of this product and said it has great ingredients. Terrific for sensitive skin.

I got the 'Vanicream Vitamin C' because I had 'Tinea Versicolor' which is the cause of an overproduction of yeast in the face. I'm 19 and this usually affects children and teens. I got it treated but after it left 'hyperpigmentation' around my nose and at the corners of my lips which made me look like I had lines there. Which made me look way older and I started getting self-conscious. After using a product for 'hyperpigmentation' and it then caused me to have 'hypopigmentation' which was worse the dark lines appeared again. I found Vanicream Vitamin C through a dermatologist on youtube who recommended it due to it having 'THD' (Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate) which is more gentle than 'L-Ascorbic Acid'. After the 'hypopigmentation' my face was sensitive so I didn't want to risk making it worse and I still had remnants of 'hypopigmentation' still. Plus I have a 'Vanicream Sensitive Skin' moisturizer and it doesn't make my skin feel oily (I have combination skin). I've been using 'Vanicream Vitamin C' for a Month (Started March 28th) and the lines have gotten lighter! I use it everyday twice a day, when I use it in the morning I make sure to always put SPF because with any 'Vitamin C' product if you use it in the morning you should always have SPF to prevent it getting worse especially since the goal is to make it better. In natural sunlight I can barely see the dark lines but they're still there. With all skincare products it can take 2-8 weeks to see results but with 'THD' it can

I have finished my 3rd tube of this product and I find it really keeps my skin healthy and soothed! The form of vitamin C in it is very effective and at a much better price than other brands that cost 3 times as much. This product is a regular step my skin care routine! I love it.
I have been using vit c for months till now , it's worked great on my sensitive skin, and don't want to change another brand . Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I have been using the vitamin c serum from vanicream for a few years. It is light and layers perfectly under sunscreen. Vitamin c makes my skin glow and doesn't cause breakouts! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

The serum is wonderful! I use it daily before my VaniCream sunscreen! It feels amazing on your face and neck! Highly recommended this product! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

My skin is pretty sensitive when it comes to vitamin c, but I LOVE this product. The consistency feels nice and hydrating and I have zero irritation using it both morning and night. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

avis.titre: Great Vitamin C for beginners and Sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is a really great vitamin C. It's not harsh and won't irritated your skin. The price is great as well Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I purchased the product multiple times from my local drugstore. The most gentle and moisturizing formula for sensitive skin or those who can not tolerate the "traditional" form of Vitamin C. I use in the Morning the follow up with a Sunscreen.
Gentle/tolerable. Not sure if it is doing anything after twice daily usage for over a month.

This product worked great for me at first, but after a few weeks of use, it started to really irritate my skin and broke me out in red blotches all over my face and neck. I've used many vitamin C serums ij the past and none have ever done this to my skin.

avis.titre: Best Vitamin C I've ever used
avis.texte: I have tried many expensive vitamin c serums and they did nothing for my skin...until this one! Not only is the price amazingly affordable but I saw results immediately after using and my skin texture and tone has improved so much. I'm 44 with dry skin, age spots and fine lines and this has made such a difference!

I was hesitant to buy another vitamin c skincare product because I always have a reaction to them. I was pleasantly surprised to see how light and weightless the consistency is. I have not had any redness, stinging or contact dermatitis at all. I've used it almost daily for a week. My skin is smoother, clearer and has a glow. I use it during the day with Vanicream Facial Moisturizer with SPF 30 - Mineral Sunscreen. This is the best sunscreen for sensitive skin.
I love any vitamin c but this one was really good, try it when it's on sale

I love this serum so much. It leaves my dry, combo, sensitive skin so hydrated and supple. I've been using it now for about a year everyday. Under moisturizer or even alone during the hot summer days.

This vit c is amazing. I am so so impressed. After 2 months my skin glows, its fuss free, and my skin LOVES this and the new sensitive skin moisturizer with ceramides. It has no minderal oil...it has squalane glycerin first two ingredients, Thats a quality moisturizer Keep updating Vanicream Im falling Im falling in love! All that Vanicream neads is a *cream cleanser* for dry skin...and I will covert to all vanicream. Anything foaming for me is a *no go* pleeeeeeeeease Vanicream. do a lotion cleanser without mineral oil and make it easy to rinse off, Like cerave hydrating but less irritaing. Im dreaming and waiting someday its gona happen!!

Like others, my face tolerated this perfectly well initially. After a few days i developed a terrible rash - perioral dermatitis as per my derm. I have ceased using anythjng and its days later and it has not cleared. This is rhe only item i added to my routine and i am so upset. I previously have used vit c from skinceuticaks and the ordinary with no issue. I am waiting on a prescription to help clear the rash.

avis.titre: This Vitamin C is better than VitCs 6 times the price (I kno
avis.texte: I'd tried so many Vitamin Cs and spent way too much money. Seriously ones that cost between $80-$120. And they would irritate my skin and not have much in the way of results. I think it's the THD and the sensitive frills free formula - but this is my favorite ever and it's the cheapest which is the best.

Wonderful for sensitive skin and rosacea. I was using medical grade skincare and it destroyed my skin and was ineffective. This serum, along with the vanicream daily moisturizing cream, repaired my skin barrier and my skin looks 100% better and its a third of the price!

avis.titre: I was able to use this daily without irritation!
avis.texte: i have sensitive, rosacea and acne prone skin. i am also very oily at this time. this was a great vitamin C treatment to try out and i have been able to incorporate this daily. i have repurchased 3x so far. all summer this was my favorite combo: vanicream vitamin c + cerave gel moisturizer + hero cosmetics force shield spf. it made my sensitive, skin happy all summer. I'm going to keep it going the rest of the year.
Burns the skin and haven't noticed any benefits for the price….

avis.titre: Best vitamin C for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love this vitamin c serum! I have fairly sensitive skin and when I've tried other vitamin c serums in the past my skin never agreed with them and would become inflamed, bumpy, and itchy. I follow a few dermatologist and skincare specialist and they all recommended this product for people with sensitive skin, and I figured its worth a shot trying out, plus it's super affordable. Oh boy am I glad I did buy this! My skin is so glowy and plump and my skintone is becoming more even toned after a month of use. I highly recommend this serum in your skincare routine, it has become a holy grail in mine 🙏🏼

I'm going to keep writing my review of this to warn others and to make sure Ulta posts this - to those with sensitive skin- this is very irritating. And the kicker is that it didn't irritate my skin on day 1, 2 or 3 of using it. Around day 4, the skin on my face was rough, dry and bumpy. This is when I stopped using it- but the irritation continued even though I stopped using it and no other skin care or makeup was in any way different. On day 5, my neck and chest turned bright red, looking like a bad sun burn. On day 6 and 7, sensitive spots under my eyes turned blood red, blotchy and sore. The worst is that some of this migrated down my chest to the top of my bosom (to use a term that won't get flagged) and now I have a bumpy rash all across the top of both of them. This is day 8 and the irritation continues.

avis.titre: Gave me a rash and dry rough skin
avis.texte: I used this for 3 days without issue. On the 3rd day at night I noticed my skin felt rough, dry and had bumps all over. The next day, my neck and chest broke out in a terrible red rash. I stopped using it but the rash got worse and then I developed a red rash under my eyes. I wish I never bought this- I wanted a less expensive vitamin c versus Skinceuticals but this is terrible. I wouldn't recommend this and would advise a 5 day patch test because the issues appear after a few days. Really turned off by this brand now.

avis.titre: Finally, a non-irritating Vitamin C serum!
avis.texte: Hands down best vitamin c serum I've ever tried. I've tried $20-150+ serums that irritated my skin, finally decided to give this a try as they say they are formulated for sensitive skin. That is the truth! No irritation, no redness no dryness. Looks seamless under makeup. Will definitely be repurchasing.

I love that this is very light weight. I have not had any skin reactions to incorporating this in my skincare routine. I apply this with my nighttime skincare routine. I believe you could use this twice a day, but I try not to layer too many products under my makeup. I took a star off only because I feel like I am going to run out of this product pretty fast. There doesn't seem to be a lot of product in the tube. I would probably repurchase this simply because I do like the way this feels on my skin.

avis.titre: the best vitamin C I've tried
avis.texte: I love this serum, and i do see a difference. It brightens my skin and helps with dark spot correction. My skin can't tolerate oily vitamin C serums, and this has a milky texture that's minimally tacky. It also has a mild pleasant scent. It was reviewed by a cosmetic chemist to be a good pick for vitamin C because of the specific derivative and the way the pump doesn't allow air into the container to oxidize the ingredient.
Love this product. Doesn't irritate my skin, very gentle on skin, dries fast, fragrance free, and affordable. I've noticed some skin tone evenness since I started using this.

I have very sensitive skin so it's hard to find a serum that doesn't break me out, this one doesn't! I also apply to my under eyes as well and feel like they are lighter but not totally gone. I definitely reccomend it :)

Bought after seeing such great reviews-and I have sensitive skin-so I was excited to try. Used one time and this product chemically burned my face. It became tight, itchy, painful-started to peel. Took 2 weeks and slathering my face in Vaseline and moisturizer to get my face back to normal. Everyones skin is different and this one certainly did not agree with me.

avis.titre: My favorite vitamin C serum EVER
avis.texte: I continually will repurchase this vitamin C - i love the airless pump as well to ensure product quality. I have sensitive skin so other vitamin C serums have irritated my skin and this applies beautifully!! I love it! Also nontoxic and all clean ingredients

Fabulous! I'm 61 years old & still struggle with cloggled pores! I have sensitive skin & even with a very strict skin care regimen, my skin can break out or react to oils in products. However, Vanicream's Vitamin C Serum is an absolute treasure of a find! I'm on my 3rd tube & no breakouts or sensitivity. My sunspots have lightened & my complexion has overall evened. This serum with ceramides is also very cost efficient, too! Overall, this has earned a permanent place in my skincare routine.
This product is sentive skin friendly, does not break you out because it does not have fragrance. Auper good vitamin c serum
I love Vanicream products for how gentle and budget friendly they are. This serum is nice, definitely more runny than others I've tried but effective!

avis.titre: This Product Didn't Work for Me
avis.texte: I wanted to try out a new vitamin C serum in my routine. After seeing such great reviews, watching multiple videos, and doing some research I thought 'let me try this product out'. I don't normally have sensitive skin, but seeing that it works for sensitive I thought it would be great on my skin. After two days of using this serum I ended up getting contact dermatitis all over my eyes and neck. So many small little bumps that were super itchy and my eyes became swollen. Everyone's skin is different and can handle different things, but something within this products ingridients didn't agree with mine.
my acne and scarring is seriously clearing up only after a short time of using. My skin is glowing from this. I love it.

avis.titre: Disappointed in Vanicream - DO A PATCH TEST
avis.texte: I have been a user of four Vanicream products for years so wanted to try their new Vitamin C serum. Upon using once I developed a burning red rash, raised bumps on my face and neck. Went to allergist and after 6 month still dealing with red bumps!

I'm serious so glad I found this serum. I've been using this for 2 weeks and I love. My skin tends to be on the sensitive side and have reacted in the past to other Vitamin C products, but have abolsutely no issues with this one! It's lightweight, adds a healthy glow without looking oily, it's not tacky/sticky, and helps with my complexion without clogging pores. PLUS-super affordable. 10/10 would recommend!

I've been using it for a week now and i can already tell a difference! My skin is so glowy and not dull anymore. Only thing to be aware of is you don't need a lot cause it will feel oily until it fully absorbs.

This is such an affordable and high quality vitamin c serum. I will repurchase when mine is empty, my skin looks brighter and healthier every time I use it. Very impressed! Very gentle and not sticky at all or oily like a lot of vitamin c serums.

avis.titre: Saw results after the first application
avis.texte: I was looking for an inexpensive vitamin c cream. I tried this one and was so surprised at how quickly I saw results! I use vitamin c for my jowls lines. After the first use, my jowls lines are not as deep. After a week of use they are almost gone! I am definitely going to continue using!

I've only been using this product for 4 days now and it is an absolute miracle! I was hesitant to try because I found that the Vanicream body moisturizer did not work well for me. The only thing that has previously been able to fix the irritated skin around my eyebrows and eyes has been steroid cream...EVERYTHING else made it worse. This is an absolutely wonderful product that leaves the skin on my face feeling great.
I've finished my first tube of this serum and I am pleased with the affects thus far. It has lightened and evened my skin tone and hopefully is having an antioxidant effect as well.
This product goes on like silk and leaves you skin feeling amazing!
This product allows my skin to glow and feel amazing, yet it works with my VERY sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Finally a Vitamin C I can use
avis.texte: I have tried several times to find a vitamin C that I could use, but each and every time, my skin would revolt. Thank you Vanicream for making a product for the rest of us!
I love the pump on this product. It makes the Vitamin C not get all orange and goopy like many others that I have tried. Love this product.
I bought some of this for my girlfriend and she is loving it. Makes me look great. Going to buy some more!
So far this product is working great. The feel on my skin is silky and smooth. too early to see the results.
I LOVE this product so much. Never have I been able to use a vitamin C product before becuase of my tricky skin. But this one feels wonderful and I am seeing results after using it.

Most vitamin c serums break out my skin or give me eczema patches, but not this one. I like it because it's gentle and affordable. I started really noticing a difference in the brightness of my skin about 3 months into using it.
An effective and affordable Vitamin C Serum that works great for my sensitive skin. I cannot recommend this product enough for anyone looking for a high-quality product with Vitamin C.

This product has improved my skin! Growing up in Colorado, my face was exposed to more sun than it should have, which created some darker spots on my forehead. I have been hesitant to try Vitamin C products in the past, given my sensitive skin. Giving Vanicream a chance, this gentle, mild product has given my skin a nice glow while reducing the visibility of my sunspots. Give this product a try. You will not be disappointed.

I was very skeptical at first, but after a month of using the product I'm absolutely in love with it and has become a daily use in my routine! I tell everyone I know that they need this product and not to waste so much money on expensive brands!

Vanicream's Vitamin C serum is a game-changer in the skincare universe. From the moment you apply it, you can feel the luxurious texture gliding smoothly on your skin. The formula is lightweight, making it easy to incorporate into your daily routine without feeling greasy or heavy.The results are nothing short of spectacular. After consistent use, my skin has a newfound radiance, and those pesky dark spots are noticeably diminished. The serum's potent blend of antioxidants seems to work like magic, leaving my complexion more even-toned and revitalized.What sets Vanicream apart is its commitment to sensitive skin. As someone prone to redness and irritation, I've struggled to find a Vitamin C serum that doesn't cause flare-ups. Vanicream's dermatologist-tested, fragrance-free formula is a true lifesaver. It's gentle yet effective, making it suitable for even the most sensitive skin types.The packaging is sleek and practical, ensuring the product remains potent. The airtight pump dispenser not only maintains the serum's efficacy but also adds a touch of elegance to my skincare routine.In conclusion, Vanicream Vitamin C is a skincare masterpiece. If you're on a quest for brighter, healthier skin without the irritation, look no further. This serum has earned its spot as a holy grail in my beauty arsenal.

I grew up in SW FL with lots of sun damage, my skin is so sensitive I never found the right Vitamin C product, until now. This serum made a visible difference in my skin, it absorbed quickly, my 56 y.o. skin has a glow and looks smoother, hydrated and healthy yet it doesn't irritate my skin. I use this in the AM before SPF and the PM before my retinol. I love that it's effective and affordable! Great product!
I seriously love this stuff! It completely brightened up my dark spots. I'm on my second one!!!

avis.titre: Wonderfully gentle and effective vitamin C serum
avis.texte: Perfect for those with sensitive skin looking for a glow and a bit of an SPF boost. Highly recommend.

This Vitamin C is gentle but effective. This Vit C It is a much gentler form than say L-Ascorbic acid that can be very irritating and not tolerated by all. I'm on my 3rd bottle and have ordered more to have on hand. Honestly I never want to be without it. Soon after putting it on I noticed a low glow and healthy radiance. I have used it now for a couple months and it has changed the my skin for the better. I notice is is brighter, smoother, more even tone, smaller pores, firmer, more plump, has helped with under eye circles, and yes at 50 more youthful! I have one more resistant dark spot and it has lightened it. This Vitamin C has a light natural clean scent to it, It glides over your skin so smoothly, doesn't pill, absorbs to a nice smooth finish, layers well under other products such as moisturizer (Vanicream Face etc), under sunscreen, tinted sunscreen, foundation, and under eye concealer perfectly. It did not irritate my skin from day one and has clearly improved my skin and calmed my cheek redness! The pump design is great...no product loss from deipoing or leaking and I have noticed no oxidation of the Vit (no color change in product). Vanicream...Please continue to expand your facial skincare product line.
This stuff works so well! I have been having a hard time finding out what works for my sensitive/combo skin and this has worked wonders in just 3 days! Hope the formula never changes!
This product is consistent with the high quality I expect from Vanicream.

Wow!!!!! The moment I put this serum on my hypersensitive skin there was no burning, swelling, or redness!!! I woke up the next morning and my face felt like butter and clearer and I look 20 years younger!!! Man ...I wished I had known about this serum before now...the amount of money I could have saved on high-end and drugstore products and going to the dermatologist because of the reaction to other products that claimed were for sensitive skin. This formula actually has no junk or herbs in it and its claims are true! Shout out to R&D and the dermatologists who oversee this product for those of us with hypersensitive skin!!! Thank you Vanicream!!!

This serum did a wonderful job of both calming down visible redness and hydrating my skin. Vitamin C serums (L-asorbic and other derivatives) usually cause itritation and breakouts for me, but this did not. The combination of gentle vitamin C and cermaides is great for sensitive skin. I would recommend it.
I was so nervous that this would irritate my skin but I'm so happy it didn't! I also use their moisturizer and face wash... my skin looks and feels great!
I just ordered my second one. It does not irritate my sensitive skin. It's lightweight and feels luxurious. My skin is improved. Thank you Vanicream!

I have been using this for only a week so too soon to see a real difference. I use it in the AM as added moisture under the facial SPF moisturizer. I do think it has lightened my under eye area. No problem with using it on my rosacea skin:)

avis.titre: Noticed a difference after first application
avis.texte: This serum made a visible difference in my skin after one application, especially in my undereye area. Wrinkles and crepiness are less apparent, and my mature facial skin now has a sort of glow to it. It looks hydrated and healthy--and dare I say, younger. I've only been using it for a few days in the morning, but I'm anxious to see how much more improvement I'll see in the weeks and months to come. It's very light, applies easily, plays well with moisturizer and makeup, and there's no stinging or irritation so far. I highly recommend giving it a try.
